entry_points.text: Enabled helpers forward namespace activation notification lookup and reference counting to the hierarchical store, with plain link rename forwarding to the namespace-aware form with no namespace.
Block controls share one type with numbers for read-only set and query, byte size, discard and zero ranges, and disk sequence.
File operations expose block mapping, freeze with integer payload and thaw, trim by range, clone by descriptor or range, and dedupe with bidirectional ranges.
Attribute controls exchange flag words, extent maps bidirectionally, extended-attribute structures, label buffers and UUID, plus shutdown with flags.

Encryption ioctls set and query versioned policies with size handshake, add and remove keys, and report presence as absent present or incompletely removed; verity ioctls enable measure and read metadata over their arguments.

exports.text: Regular entries bind a name with a validated mode and optional show and store callbacks, with read-only and read-write shorthands implying the matching callback and a null terminator ending the list.

Binary entries bind name mode extent and read/write callbacks with a read-write shorthand, group helpers build a singleton and terminated list from a same-named array, and binary init forwards to the base initializer.
When disabled, directory group removal notification and init helpers do nothing or report success, while emit helpers report zero bytes.
Boot exposes a loops parser with per-CPU loops storage, plus default mount flags, a saved root name buffer, a wait setting and the chosen root device number.

hazards.text: Scan and query structures rely on caller size for versioning, overlong names fail rather than truncate, permission filtering requires all bits, and covering-or-next falls back to later areas.
Key removal reports busy files and other users as separate outputs rather than simple success.

Malformed option values are rejected without aborting boot, bad timeouts warn and use indefinite wait, and allocation failure or unopenable targets or exhausted filesystems halt after listing candidates.
Native flag and version ioctls use long payloads while compat forms use integers so reuse corrupts high bits, and page categories distinguish present and swapped states.

invariants.text: A group helper reports invisible for index zero when the group predicate denies it and otherwise delegates to per-entry visibility; modes must keep readability non-increasing, writability non-increasing to group, and other non-writable.
Listing is allowed when no list hook exists or the hook approves the entry; simple stores cap user entries and total bytes, and the argument size is fixed with latest equal to initial.
Queries resume by copying the last record into the low key; owners pack type above code, one flag marks the final record, and the query uses a letter-X ioctl over the header.

Direct timing spans one tick or HZ over one hundred with up to five retries keeping agreeing samples and discarding wraps, absent support fails at once, and convergent mode brackets one tick then halves to eight-bit precision.

Read-only and read-write accept only empty values from a read-only silent default; numeric wait converts seconds to milliseconds with overflow to indefinite wait, lists split in place, one attempt mounts at the early root and retries flush releases.

Two directory flag names share one value, the supported read-write mask and combined sync range are unions of their bits, user masks bound flag ioctls, and label capacity bounds label buffers with smaller per-filesystem limits allowed.

state_machines.text: Calibration prefers cached per-CPU value then preset then fine then known then direct measurement then convergence, direct failure falls through, and publishing records per-CPU and global values with single-shot reporting and a completion hook.

Generic mounting tries the requested list or all block filesystems tolerating access and argument failures; nodev tries only device-less types stopping at first success with block creating a well-known node first, then retries once read-only else lists candidates and halts.

Top level dispatches by device kind with zero device trying nodev then falling through to block; network roots retry up to five times sleeping from five seconds doubling to thirty seconds, and missing server data or exhaustion fails.

structs.text: A group holds a name with regular and binary visibility and sizing hooks plus member lists; a binary descriptor adds size private mapping read write seek and map hooks to a base attribute; file ops expose show and store.

A handler carries name prefix and flags with optional list and get/set hooks; a simple carrier holds name value and length; the cache holds a hash table with linked entries carrying name size and trailing payload.
Block shift ten yields one thousand twenty four byte blocks, and initial and hard open-file limits bound file tables.
Seek origins cover start current end data and hole with maximum equal to hole, and rename flags select no-replace exchange and whiteout as low bits.

Clone carries source descriptor offsets and length, trim carries start and length, dedupe pairs source extent with per-destination status using zero for same and one for differs with reserved words cleared, and inode attributes pair flags extents project and CoW sizes.
Extent flags request realtime placement immutability append-only direct access and verity, and inode flags mirror immutability verity and no-copy-on-write.
Per-operation flags use a bitwise type with durability no-wait append and atomic bits, and shutdown takes default log-flush or no-log-flush modes.

Version one policy holds version modes flags and descriptor while version two holds version modes flags and identifier with a raw key buffer; specifier type selects descriptor or identifier, with XTS mode and a direct-key flag.

Space records hold device flags offsets owner and length with a header holding flags counts keys and trailing records; verity enable carries version algorithm block salt and signature, digests carry algorithm size and bytes, and descriptors record version algorithm size root and salt.
